sub-database-3.1: SELECT snippet_id, SUM(rouge_1_f) AS cumulative_rouge_1_f1_score FROM quality_scores GROUP BY snippet_id ORDER BY snippet_id;
sub-database-3.2: SELECT snippet_id FROM snippet_usage WHERE is_successful = 1 GROUP BY snippet_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.3: SELECT cs.snippet_id, cs.description, cs.reference_code, q.rouge_1_f, q.explanation_quality, u.usage_count, c.comment_count FROM code_snippets cs JOIN quality_scores q ON cs.snippet_id = q.snippet_id JOIN (SELECT snippet_id, COUNT(*) as usage_count FROM snippet_usage GROUP BY snippet_id) u ON cs.snippet_id = u.snippet_id JOIN (SELECT snippet_id, COUNT(*) as comment_count FROM snippet_comments GROUP BY snippet_id) c ON cs.snippet_id = c.snippet_id ORDER BY q.rouge_1_f DESC, q.explanation_quality DESC, u.usage_count DESC, c.comment_count DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.4: SELECT cs.snippet_id, u.user_name, COUNT(sc.comment_id) AS total_comments FROM code_snippets cs JOIN users u ON cs.uploaded_by = u.user_id LEFT JOIN snippet_comments sc ON cs.snippet_id = sc.snippet_id GROUP BY cs.snippet_id, u.user_name ORDER BY cs.snippet_id;
sub-database-3.5: SELECT cs.snippet_id, cs.description, cs.language_id, so.uploaded_by, cs.upload_date, cs.last_modified, qs.rouge_1_f AS quality_score, COUNT(CASE WHEN su.is_successful = 1 THEN su.usage_id END) AS successful_usages, COUNT(CASE WHEN su.is_successful = 0 THEN su.usage_id END) AS unsuccessful_usages, COUNT(su.usage_id) AS total_usages FROM code_snippets cs JOIN snippet_ownership so ON cs.snippet_id = so.snippet_id LEFT JOIN snippet_quality_scores qs ON cs.snippet_id = qs.snippet_id LEFT JOIN snippet_usage su ON cs.snippet_id = su.snippet_id GROUP BY cs.snippet_id, cs.description, cs.language_id, so.uploaded_by, cs.upload_date, cs.last_modified, qs.rouge_1_f ORDER BY COUNT(CASE WHEN su.is_successful = 1 THEN su.usage_id END) DESC, COUNT(su.usage_id) DESC;
sub-database-3.6: SELECT T1.DESCRIPTION, T2.LANGUAGE_NAME FROM CODE_SNIPPETS AS T1 JOIN PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGES AS T2 ON T1.LANGUAGE_ID = T2.LANGUAGE_ID JOIN SNIPPET_RATINGS AS T3 ON T1.SNIPPET_ID = T3.SNIPPET_ID JOIN (SELECT SNIPPET_ID, COUNT(*) AS RATING_COUNT, AVG(RATING_VALUE) AS AVERAGE_RATING FROM SNIPPET_RATINGS GROUP BY SNIPPET_ID ORDER BY RATING_COUNT DESC, AVERAGE_RATING DESC LIMIT 11) AS T4 ON T3.SNIPPET_ID = T4.SNIPPET_ID ORDER BY T4.RATING_COUNT DESC, T4.AVERAGE_RATING DESC
sub-database-3.7: SELECT AVG(r.rating_value) AS avg_rating FROM snippet_ratings r JOIN quality_scores q ON r.snippet_id = q.snippet_id JOIN snippet_usage u ON r.snippet_id = u.snippet_id WHERE r.is_flagged = 0 AND q.is_flagged = 0 AND u.is_successful = 1 GROUP BY r.snippet_id, q.explanation_quality, u.usage_type;
sub-database-3.8: SELECT cs.snippet_id, cs.description, AVG(sr.rating_value) AS avg_rating, COUNT(stm.tag_id) AS num_tags, COUNT(scm.category_id) AS num_categories FROM code_snippets cs LEFT JOIN snippet_ratings sr ON cs.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id LEFT JOIN snippet_tag_mapping stm ON cs.snippet_id = stm.snippet_id LEFT JOIN snippet_category_mapping scm ON cs.snippet_id = scm.snippet_id GROUP BY cs.snippet_id, cs.description ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, num_tags DESC, num_categories DESC;
sub-database-3.9: SELECT u.user_id, u.name, SUM(q.rouge_1_f) AS cumulative_quality_score FROM users u JOIN snippet_versions sv ON u.user_id = sv.created_by JOIN quality_scores q ON sv.snippet_id = q.snippet_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name ORDER BY u.name ASC;
sub-database-3.10: SELECT T3.description, AVG(T2.rouge_1_f) AS avg_rouge_1_f FROM snippet_versions AS T1 JOIN quality_scores AS T2 ON T1.snippet_id = T2.snippet_id JOIN code_snippets AS T3 ON T1.snippet_id = T3.snippet_id WHERE T3.description IS NOT NULL AND T2.rouge_1_f IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T3.description ORDER BY avg_rouge_1_f DESC
sub-database-3.11: SELECT cs.description AS description, cs.complexity AS complexity_score, AVG(sr.rating_value) AS average_quality_score, COUNT(DISTINCT uv.version_id) AS tag_count, SUM(uv.usage_pattern) AS usage_pattern, MAX(sr.rating_value) AS average_rating FROM code_snippets cs JOIN snippet_versions uv ON cs.snippet_id = uv.snippet_id JOIN snippet_ratings sr ON cs.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id ORDER BY cs.complexity DESC, MAX(sr.rating_value) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT uv.version_id) DESC;
sub-database-3.12: SELECT T1.snippet_id FROM code_snippets AS T1 JOIN snippet_usage AS T2 ON T1.snippet_id = T2.snippet_id WHERE T2.usage_type = 'execute' ORDER BY T2.usage_date DESC LIMIT 1
sub-database-3.13: SELECT T4.language_id AS language_id, T4.name AS language_name, SUM(T1.complexity) AS total_complexity, AVG(T1.complexity) * COUNT(T2.snippet_id) AS weighted_complexity, MAX(T2.snippet_count) AS max_snippet_count, T3.user_id AS top_user_id, T3.username AS top_user_name, T2.snippet_count AS snippet_count_top_user FROM snippet_ratings T1 JOIN snippet_ownership T2 ON T1.snippet_id = T2.snippet_id JOIN users T3 ON T2.user_id = T3.user_id JOIN code_snippets T4 ON T1.language_id = T4.language_id WHERE T2.is_public = 1 GROUP BY T4.language_id, T3.user_id ORDER BY T4.name, T2.snippet_count, T3.snippet_count_top_user;
sub-database-3.14: SELECT snippet_id FROM ( SELECT snippet_id, AVG(quality_scores.rouge_1_f) AS avg_rouge_1_f, quality_scores.explanation_quality, AVG(snippet_ratings.rating_value) AS avg_rating, COUNT(snippet_usage.usage_id) AS usage_count FROM quality_scores JOIN snippet_ratings ON quality_scores.snippet_id = snippet_ratings.snippet_id JOIN snippet_usage ON snippet_ratings.snippet_id = snippet_usage.snippet_id WHERE quality_scores.is_flagged = 0 AND snippet_ratings.is_flagged = 0 AND snippet_usage.is_successful = 1 GROUP BY snippet_id ) AS ranked_snippets ORDER BY avg_rouge_1_f DESC, explanation_quality DESC, avg_rating DESC, usage_count DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.15: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, su.usage_date, SUM(CASE WHEN su.is_successful = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY u.user_id ORDER BY su.usage_date) AS running_total FROM users u JOIN snippet_usage su ON u.user_id = su.user_id JOIN snippet_ownership so ON u.user_id = so.user_id AND so.snippet_id = su.snippet_id JOIN snippet_comments sc ON so.snippet_id = sc.snippet_id AND u.user_id = sc.user_id WHERE su.is_successful = 1 AND sc.rating_value >= 4 ORDER BY u.user_id, su.usage_date;
sub-database-3.16: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.created_date, q.created_date AS score_date, q.rouge_1_f FROM users u JOIN quality_scores q ON u.user_id = q.snippet_id ORDER BY q.created_date
sub-database-3.17: SELECT cs.snippet_id, u.user_name, pl.language_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN su.usage_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_views, COALESCE(AVG(sr.rating_value), 0) AS average_ratings, COALESCE(COUNT(sc.comment_id), 0) AS total_comments FROM code_snippets cs JOIN users u ON cs.uploaded_by = u.user_id JOIN programming_languages pl ON cs.language_id = pl.language_id LEFT JOIN snippet_usage su ON cs.snippet_id = su.snippet_id LEFT JOIN snippet_ratings sr ON cs.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id LEFT JOIN snippet_comments sc ON cs.snippet_id = sc.snippet_id GROUP BY cs.snippet_id, u.user_name, pl.language_name
sub-database-3.18: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM snippet_usage WHERE usage_type = 'view' AND is_successful = 1 AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_permissions WHERE role IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.19: SELECT T4.name FROM code_snippets AS T1 JOIN snippet_ownership AS T2 ON T1.snippet_id = T2.snippet_id JOIN snippet_usage AS T3 ON T1.snippet_id = T3.snippet_id JOIN users AS T4 ON T2.user_id = T4.user_id WHERE T3.is_successful = 1 GROUP BY T4.name ORDER BY AVG(T1.complexity * T3.usage_date * T3.is_successful) DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.20: SELECT qs.rouge_1_f, AVG(sr.rating_value), COUNT(sr.rating_id) FROM quality_scores qs JOIN snippet_ratings sr ON qs.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id WHERE qs.snippet_id = 1 GROUP BY qs.rouge_1_f;
sub-database-3.21: SELECT cs.snippet_id, cl.language_id FROM code_snippets cs JOIN (SELECT language_id, snippet_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY language_id ORDER BY q.rouge_1_f DESC, sr.rating_count DESC, sc.comment_count DESC) as rank FROM code_snippets cs JOIN quality_scores q ON cs.snippet_id = q.snippet_id JOIN (SELECT snippet_id, COUNT(*) as rating_count FROM snippet_ratings sr GROUP BY snippet_id) sr ON cs.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id JOIN (SELECT snippet_id, COUNT(*) as comment_count FROM snippet_comments sc GROUP BY snippet_id) sc ON cs.snippet_id = sc.snippet_id ) subq ON cs.snippet_id = subq.snippet_id AND cl.language_id = subq.language_id AND subq.rank = 1 JOIN code_languages cl ON cs.language_id = cl.language_id
sub-database-3.22: SELECT s.snippet_id, s.title, AVG(q.rouge_1_r + q.rouge_1_f) AS avg_quality_score, AVG(r.rating_value) AS avg_rating, COUNT(u.usage_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.rating_id) AS normalized_usage_count FROM snippets s JOIN quality_scores q ON s.snippet_id = q.snippet_id JOIN snippet_ratings r ON s.snippet_id = r.snippet_id JOIN snippet_usage u ON s.snippet_id = u.snippet_id GROUP BY s.snippet_id, s.title ORDER BY (avg_quality_score + avg_rating) * 1.5 + normalized_usage_count / 2 DESC LIMIT 11;
sub-database-3.23: SELECT s.snippet_id, s.title, SUM(CASE WHEN su.usage_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS views, SUM(CASE WHEN su.usage_type = 'copy' AND su.is_successful = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_copies, SUM(CASE WHEN su.usage_type = 'execute' AND su.is_successful = 1 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_executions, AVG(qs.rouge_1_f) AS avg_rouge_1_f, AVG(s.rating) AS avg_rating FROM snippets s JOIN snippet_usage su ON s.snippet_id = su.snippet_id JOIN quality_scores qs ON s.snippet_id = qs.snippet_id GROUP BY s.snippet_id, s.title ORDER BY (views + successful_copies * 3 + successful_executions * 5) * avg_rouge_1_f * avg_rating DESC LIMIT 11;
sub-database-3.24: SELECT cs.reference_code AS code_snippet, COUNT(du.usage_id) AS usage_count, AVG(sr.rating_value) AS average_rating, MAX(sr.rating_value) AS max_rating, MAX(vc.rouge_1_f1_score) AS max_rouge_1_f1_score, du.usage_rank FROM code_snippets cs JOIN snippet_usage du ON cs.snippet_id = du.snippet_id JOIN (SELECT snippet_id, MAX(rating_value) AS max_rating, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rating_value DESC) AS usage_rank FROM snippet_ratings GROUP BY snippet_id) sr ON cs.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id JOIN (SELECT snippet_id, version_number, MAX(rouge_1_f1_score) AS max_rouge_1_f1_score FROM snippet_versions WHERE is_released = 1 GROUP BY snippet_id, version_number) vc ON cs.snippet_id = vc.snippet_id AND sr.max_rating = vc.max_rouge_1_f1_score GROUP BY cs.snippet_id ORDER BY usage_count DESC, max_rouge_1_f1_score DESC LIMIT 6;
sub-database-3.25: SELECT s.snippet_id, s.description, AVG(sr.rating_value) AS avg_rating, COUNT(sv.version_id) AS total_versions, MAX(sc.comment_date) AS latest_comment_date, COUNT(st.tag_id) AS total_tags, u.user_id AS owner_id FROM snippet_versions sv JOIN snippets s ON sv.snippet_id = s.snippet_id JOIN snippet_ratings sr ON s.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id JOIN snippet_comments sc ON s.snippet_id = sc.snippet_id JOIN user_permissions up ON s.created_by = up.user_id JOIN snippet_tags st ON s.snippet_id = st.snippet_id WHERE up.user_name = 'Bob Williams' GROUP BY s.snippet_id, s.description, u.user_id ORDER BY s.snippet_id;
sub-database-3.26: SELECT cs.snippet_id, cs.description, SUM(du.usage_count) AS total_usage_count, AVG(qs.rouge_1_f) AS average_rouge_1_f_score FROM code_snippets cs JOIN snippet_usage du ON cs.snippet_id = du.snippet_id JOIN quality_scores qs ON cs.snippet_id = qs.snippet_id GROUP BY cs.snippet_id, cs.description ORDER BY total_usage_count DESC, average_rouge_1_f_score DESC;
sub-database-3.27: SELECT cu.user_id, cu.user_name, cs.reference_code, AVG(r.rating_value) AS avg_score FROM code_snippets cs JOIN snippet_usage su ON cs.snippet_id = su.snippet_id JOIN snippet_ratings r ON cs.snippet_id = r.snippet_id AND su.user_id = r.user_id JOIN snippet_ownership so ON cs.snippet_id = so.snippet_id AND su.user_id = so.user_id JOIN code_users cu ON so.user_id = cu.user_id WHERE su.is_successful = 1 GROUP BY cu.user_id, cs.reference_code ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.28: SELECT u.user_name FROM snippet_ratings sr JOIN users u ON sr.user_id = u.user_id JOIN code_snippets cs ON sr.snippet_id = cs.snippet_id WHERE sr.rating_value > 4 ORDER BY sr.rating_value DESC LIMIT 6
sub-database-3.29: SELECT qs.human_explanation AS description, AVG(sr.rating_value) AS average_rating, st.tag_name FROM snippet_ratings sr JOIN quality_scores qs ON sr.snippet_id = qs.snippet_id JOIN snippet_tags st ON qs.snippet_id = st.snippet_id JOIN snippet_usage su ON st.snippet_id = su.snippet_id WHERE sr.is_flagged = 0 AND st.is_active = 1 AND su.is_successful = 1 AND sr.snippet_id NOT IN (SELECT snippet_id FROM snippet_ratings WHERE is_archived = 1) GROUP BY qs.human_explanation, st.tag_name ORDER BY average_rating DESC;
sub-database-3.30: SELECT so.user_id, cs.name FROM snippet_ownership so JOIN code_snippets cs ON so.user_id = cs.uploaded_by JOIN snippet_usage su ON so.snippet_id = su.snippet_id JOIN snippet_ratings sr ON so.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id JOIN quality_scores qs ON so.snippet_id = qs.snippet_id GROUP BY so.user_id, cs.name ORDER BY SUM(su.usage_count) DESC, AVG(qs.rouge_1_f) DESC;
sub-database-3.31: SELECT s.snippet_id, s.code_snippet, (COUNT(du.usage_id) * 10 + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN du.is_successful = 1 THEN du.usage_id END) * 5 + AVG(sr.rating_value) * 100 + AVG(qs.rouge_1_f) * 100 + COUNT(up.mapping_id) * 5 + COUNT(DISTINCT sc.comment_id) * 5) / 600.0 AS comprehensive_score FROM snippets s LEFT JOIN snippet_usage du ON s.snippet_id = du.snippet_id LEFT JOIN snippet_ratings sr ON s.snippet_id = sr.snippet_id AND sr.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE is_active = 1) LEFT JOIN quality_scores qs ON s.snippet_id = qs.snippet_id AND qs.created_by IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE is_active = 1) LEFT JOIN user_permissions up ON s.snippet_id = up.permission_id AND up.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE is_active = 1) LEFT JOIN snippet_comments sc ON s.snippet_id = sc.snippet_id AND sc.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE is_active = 1) GROUP BY s.snippet_id, s.code_snippet ORDER BY comprehensive_score DESC;
sub-database-3.32: SELECT c.city_id, c.city_name, c.population AS city_population_2019, c.density AS city_density, c.timezone, c.city_description, c.elevation, c.area, c.founding_date, MAX(ph.year) AS first_year_record, ph.population AS first_year_population, dh.year AS first_density_year, dh.density AS first_density, cr.year AS first_ranking_year, cr.ranking AS first_ranking FROM cities c LEFT JOIN population_history ph ON c.city_id = ph.city_id AND ph.year = 2019 LEFT JOIN density_history dh ON c.city_id = dh.city_id AND dh.year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM density_history WHERE city_id = c.city_id) LEFT JOIN city_rankings cr ON c.city_id = cr.city_id AND cr.year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM city_rankings WHERE city_id = c.city_id) GROUP BY c.city_id, c.city_name, c.population, c.density, c.timezone, c.city_description, c.elevation, c.area, c.founding_date ORDER BY c.city_id;
sub-database-3.33: SELECT c.city_name, c.population, d.density, c.lng, c.lat, c.founding_date, c.last_updated, s.state_name, COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count, GROUP_CONCAT(al.ip_address) AS ip_addresses, MAX(al.access_date) AS latest_access_date FROM cities c JOIN state_names s ON c.state_id = s.state_id LEFT JOIN density_history d ON c.city_id = d.city_id AND d.year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM density_history WHERE city_id = c.city_id) LEFT JOIN access_logs al ON c.city_id = al.city_id WHERE c.ranking IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.city_id, c.city_name, c.population, d.density, c.lng, c.lat, c.founding_date, c.last_updated, s.state_name ORDER BY c.population DESC;
sub-database-3.34: SELECT cr.city_id, ch.city_name, cl.access_date, cr.year AS ranking_year, ch.population, ch.density, COUNT(al.access_id) AS cumulative_access_count FROM city_rankings cr JOIN cities ch ON cr.city_id = ch.city_id JOIN access_logs al ON ch.city_id = al.city_id WHERE cr.criteria = 'population' GROUP BY cr.city_id, ch.city_name, cl.access_date, cr.year ORDER BY ch.city_name, cr.year, cl.access_date;
sub-database-3.35: SELECT cities.city_name FROM cities JOIN access_logs ON cities.city_id = access_logs.city_id GROUP BY cities.city_name ORDER BY COUNT(access_logs.access_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.36: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) FROM density_history WHERE density > (SELECT density FROM density_history WHERE year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM density_history WHERE city_id = density_history.city_id))
sub-database-3.37: SELECT year, SUM(population) AS total_population, MAX(density) AS max_density FROM cities JOIN density_history ON cities.city_id = density_history.city_id WHERE state_id = 'NY' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
sub-database-3.38: SELECT c.city_name, s.state_name FROM cities c JOIN states s ON c.state_id = s.state_id JOIN ( SELECT city_id, MAX(last_updated) AS max_last_updated FROM access_logs GROUP BY city_id ) al ON c.city_id = al.city_id JOIN access_logs al2 ON al.city_id = al2.city_id AND al.max_last_updated = al2.last_updated WHERE c.population_history = ( SELECT MAX(population_history.history_id) FROM population_history WHERE population_history.city_id = c.city_id ) ORDER BY c.population DESC
sub-database-3.39: SELECT s.state_id, s.state_name, SUM(ph.population - p.population) AS total_population_change, SUM(dh.density - d.density) AS total_density_change, s.timezone FROM states s JOIN counties c ON s.state_id = c.state_id JOIN population_history ph ON c.county_fips = c.county_fips AND ph.year > 0 JOIN population_history p ON c.county_fips = c.county_fips AND p.year = 0 JOIN density_history dh ON c.county_fips = dh.city_id AND dh.year > 0 JOIN density_history d ON c.county_fips = d.city_id AND d.year = 0 GROUP BY s.state_id, s.state_name, s.timezone ORDER BY c.city_id
sub-database-3.40: SELECT cities.city_name, cities.state_id, SUM(cities.population) AS total_population FROM cities JOIN city_data_versions ON cities.city_id = city_data_versions.city_id WHERE city_data_versions.version_date = (SELECT MAX(version_date) FROM city_data_versions WHERE city_id = cities.city_id) GROUP BY cities.city_name, cities.state_id ORDER BY cities.state_id, cities.city_name

sub-database-3.97: SELECT T1.stop_name, T1.avg_total + (CASE WHEN T2.maintenance_date >= DATE_SUBSTR(DATE('now'), 0, 8) THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) AS adjusted_total_ridership FROM bus_stops AS T1 LEFT JOIN maintenance_logs AS T2 ON T1.stop_id = T2.stop_id ORDER BY adjusted_total_ridership DESC
sub-database-3.98: SELECT bs.stop_id, bs.stop_name, SUM(bsm.maintenance_cost) AS total_maintenance_cost FROM bus_stops bs JOIN stop_services ss ON bs.stop_id = ss.stop_id JOIN bus_stops_maintenance bsm ON bs.stop_id = bsm.stop_id JOIN ( SELECT user_id, stop_id, MAX(feedback_time) AS max_feedback_time FROM feedback WHERE is_resolved = 'Unresolved' GROUP BY user_id, stop_id ) f ON bs.stop_id = f.stop_id AND bsm.feedback_time = f.max_feedback_time GROUP BY bs.stop_id, bs.stop_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) > 0
sub-database-3.99: SELECT bs.stop_name, COALESCE(SUM(rd.avg_total), 0) AS total_annual_ridership, COALESCE(AVG(f.rating), 0) AS average_user_rating FROM bus_stops bs LEFT JOIN ridership_data rd ON bs.stop_id = rd.stop_id LEFT JOIN feedback f ON bs.stop_id = f.stop_id GROUP BY bs.stop_name ORDER BY bs.stop_name ASC
sub-database-3.100: SELECT T2.stop_name FROM feedback AS T1 JOIN bus_stops AS T2 ON T1.stop_id = T2.stop_id WHERE T2.current_service = 1 AND T2.service_status_id = (SELECT service_status_id FROM service_status WHERE status_name = 'Active') GROUP BY T2.stop_name ORDER BY AVG(T1.rating) DESC LIMIT 1
sub-database-3.101: SELECT sp.real_price FROM stock_prices sp JOIN predictions p ON sp.stock_id = p.stock_id WHERE sp.stock_id = (SELECT stock_id FROM predictions WHERE ticker = 'MSFT') AND p.model_name = 'BullishTrendModel' AND sp.date >= p.prediction_date ORDER BY sp.date ASC

sub-database-3.103: SELECT u.user_id, s.ticker, s.company_name, MAX(p.predicted_price) AS cumulative_predicted_price, COUNT(al.access_id) AS number_of_prediction_views, MAX(al.access_date) AS most_recent_access_date, m.model_name FROM users u JOIN stocks s ON u.user_id = s.user_id JOIN predictions p ON s.stock_id = p.stock_id AND u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN access_logs al ON p.prediction_id = al.prediction_id WHERE al.access_type = 'view' GROUP BY u.user_id, s.ticker, s.company_name, m.model_name ORDER BY u.user_id, MAX(al.access_date) LIMIT 100
sub-database-3.104: SELECT s.ticker, AVG(p.predicted_price) AS avg_predicted_price, s.view_count FROM stocks s JOIN predictions p ON s.stock_id = p.stock_id WHERE s.dividend_yield > 0 AND s.market_cap > 500 GROUP BY s.ticker, s.view_count ORDER BY avg_predicted_price DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.105: SELECT s.ticker, COUNT(p.stock_id) AS total_access_counts, AVG(p.predicted_price) AS average_predicted_price FROM stocks s JOIN predictions p ON s.stock_id = p.stock_id GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.ticker ORDER BY total_access_counts DESC, average_predicted_price DESC;
sub-database-3.106: SELECT s.ticker FROM stocks s JOIN access_logs a ON s.stock_id = a.stock_id GROUP BY s.ticker ORDER BY COUNT(a.access_id) DESC LIMIT 1
sub-database-3.107: SELECT s.ticker, s.company_name, AVG(sp.real_price) AS avg_price, MAX(sp.high_price) AS max_price, MIN(sp.low_price) AS min_price, SUM(sp.volume) AS total_volume, MAX(st.user_engagement) AS max_user_engagement, MIN(pr.root_mean_squared_percentage_error) AS min_rmse FROM stocks s JOIN stock_prices sp ON s.stock_id = sp.stock_id JOIN (SELECT stock_id, MAX(relative_strength_index) AS user_engagement FROM stock_prices GROUP BY stock_id) st ON s.stock_id = st.stock_id JOIN predictions pr ON s.stock_id = pr.stock_id GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.ticker, s.company_name ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.108: SELECT stocks.stock_id, predictions.prediction_date, AVG(predictions.mean_absolute_error) AS cumulative_mean_absolute_error FROM predictions JOIN stocks ON predictions.stock_id = stocks.stock_id GROUP BY stocks.stock_id, predictions.prediction_date ORDER BY stocks.stock_id, predictions.prediction_date;
sub-database-3.109: SELECT s.stock_id, p.prediction_date, s.real_price, p.predicted_price, a.access_count FROM stocks s JOIN predictions p ON s.stock_id = p.stock_id JOIN (SELECT stock_id, COUNT(*) AS access_count, access_date FROM access_logs WHERE stock_id = 1 GROUP BY stock_id, access_date) a ON s.stock_id = a.stock_id AND p.prediction_date = a.access_date WHERE s.stock_id = 1 ORDER BY p.prediction_date;
sub-database-3.110: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.role, COUNT(DISTINCT s.stock_id) AS unique_stocks_accessed, COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_accesses, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.model_name) AS models_worked_with, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.ticker) AS stocks_worked_on, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pr.prediction_date) AS prediction_dates, AVG(pr.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score, AVG(pr.root_mean_squared_percentage_error) AS avg_rmse_percentage FROM users u LEFT JOIN access_logs al ON u.user_id = al.user_id LEFT JOIN predictions pr ON al.stock_id = pr.stock_id AND al.user_id = pr.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.role;

sub-database-3.130: SELECT T1.bin_id, T1.cumulative_event_rate, T2.created_by FROM event_bins AS T1 JOIN event_reports AS T2 ON T1.bin_id = T2.bin_id WHERE T1.cumulative_event_rate = (SELECT MAX(T3.cumulative_event_rate) FROM event_bins AS T3) ORDER BY T1.cumulative_event_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.131: SELECT ea.user_id, ad.role, dp.department, ea.bin_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ea.access_id) AS num_unique_actions, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.action_type = 'download' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS download_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.action_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_count, MAX(ea.access_timestamp) AS max_accesses, MAX(ea.access_timestamp) AS last_access_time, es.mean, es.median, es.std_dev, es.variance, es.min_value, es.max_value, es.quartiles, es.skewness, es.kurtosis, es.total_samples, es.event_count, es.non_event_count, es.event_rate, es.population_pct, es.cumulative_event_pct, es.cumulative_non_event_pct, es.ks_statistic, es.cap_rate, es.cumulative_event_rate, es.demographic_distribution, es.geographic_location, es.time_period, es.source, es.confidence_level, es.comments FROM event_access_logs ea JOIN event_bins eb ON ea.bin_id = eb.bin_id JOIN admin_logs adl ON eb.admin_id = adl.admin_id JOIN admin_details ad ON adl.admin_id = ad.admin_id JOIN department dp ON ad.department_id = dp.department_id JOIN event_statistics es ON ea.bin_id = es.bin_id WHERE ea.access_timestamp BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-30' GROUP BY ea.user_id, ad.role, dp.department, ea.bin_id ORDER BY ad.role, dp.department, ea.access_timestamp DESC;
sub-database-3.132: SELECT up.user_name, up.role, eb.bin_range, eb.cumulative_event_rate FROM user_profiles up JOIN event_bins eb ON up.user_id = eb.user_id JOIN event_access_logs la ON up.user_id = la.user_id JOIN event_statistics es ON eb.bin_id = es.bin_id WHERE la.access_timestamp = ( SELECT MAX(la1.access_timestamp) FROM event_access_logs la1 WHERE la1.user_id = up.user_id )
sub-database-3.134: SELECT T3.location, T3.total_samples FROM event_bins AS T1 JOIN event_statistics AS T2 ON T1.bin_id = T2.bin_id JOIN event_bins AS T3 ON T1.cumulative_event_rate = T3.cumulative_event_rate GROUP BY T3.location, T3.total_samples ORDER BY SUM(T2.event_rate) DESC;

sub-database-3.144: SELECT eb.bin_id, eb.cumulative_event_rate, es.mean, es.median, es.std_dev, es.variance, es.min_value, es.max_value, es.quartiles, es.skewness, es.kurtosis, ea.total_samples, ea.event_count, ea.non_event_count, ea.event_rate, ea.population_pct, ea.cumulative_event_pct, ea.cumulative_non_event_pct, ea.ks_statistic, ea.cap_rate, ea.demographic_distribution, ea.geographic_location, ea.time_period, ea.source, ea.confidence_level, er.download_frequencies, er.status FROM event_bins eb JOIN event_statistics es ON eb.bin_id = es.bin_id JOIN (SELECT bin_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN action_type = 'download' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS download_frequencies, MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status FROM event_access_logs GROUP BY bin_id) er ON eb.bin_id = er.bin_id WHERE es.statistic_id IS NOT NULL;
sub-database-3.145: SELECT eb.bin_id, es.cumulative_event_rate, eb.time_period, da.user_id, da.action_type, da.access_timestamp FROM event_bins eb JOIN event_statistics es ON eb.bin_id = es.bin_id JOIN (SELECT bin_id, MAX(access_timestamp) AS max_timestamp FROM event_access_logs GROUP BY bin_id) latest_log ON eb.bin_id = latest_log.bin_id JOIN event_access_logs da ON latest_log.bin_id = da.bin_id AND latest_log.max_timestamp = da.access_timestamp ORDER BY eb.bin_id, eb.time_period;
sub-database-3.146: SELECT eb.bin_id, eb.demographic_distribution, eb.geographic_location, eb.event_rate, es.mean, es.median, es.std_dev, es.variance, COUNT(CASE WHEN ea.action_type = 'view' THEN ea.access_id END) AS view_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ea.action_type = 'download' THEN ea.access_id END) AS download_count, up.user_name, up.department, up.role, elr.notification_text, elr.created_at, elr.read_status, elr.type, elr.priority FROM event_bins eb JOIN event_statistics es ON eb.bin_id = es.bin_id JOIN event_access_logs ea ON eb.bin_id = ea.bin_id JOIN user_profiles up ON ea.user_id = up.user_id JOIN event_reports er ON eb.bin_id = er.bin_id JOIN event_logs_readers elr ON er.report_id = elr.report_id WHERE eb.bin_id = 0 GROUP BY eb.bin_id, es.mean, es.median, es.std_dev, es.variance, up.user_name, up.department, up.role, elr.notification_text, elr.created_at, elr.read_status, elr.type, elr.priority ORDER BY ea.access_timestamp DESC, elr.created_at DESC;
sub-database-3.147: SELECT eb.bin_id, CASE WHEN ea.access_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Accessed' ELSE 'Not Accessed' END AS accessed_status, COALESCE(ea.user_id, 'N/A') AS accessed_by, COALESCE(MAX(ea.access_timestamp), 'N/A') AS last_accessed_at, es.cumulative_event_rate AS cumulative_event_rate FROM event_bins eb LEFT JOIN event_access_logs ea ON eb.bin_id = ea.bin_id LEFT JOIN event_statistics es ON eb.bin_id = es.bin_id GROUP BY eb.bin_id ORDER BY eb.bin_id;
sub-database-3.148: SELECT eb.bin_id, eb.bin_range, eb.event_count, er.mean, er.median, er.std_dev, COUNT(ea.access_id) AS access_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ea.action_type = 'admin' THEN ea.action_type ELSE NULL END) AS admin_action_count FROM event_bins eb LEFT JOIN event_access_logs ea ON eb.bin_id = ea.bin_id LEFT JOIN event_reports er ON eb.bin_id = er.bin_id WHERE ea.action_type IN ('view', 'download') GROUP BY eb.bin_id, eb.bin_range ORDER BY eb.cumulative_event_rate ASC;
sub-database-3.149: SELECT up.user_id, up.user_name, up.role, COUNT(DISTINCT ea.bin_id) AS unique_bin_count, AVG(es.mean) AS avg_event_rate FROM user_profiles up JOIN event_access_logs ea ON up.user_id = ea.user_id LEFT JOIN event_statistics es ON ea.bin_id = es.bin_id GROUP BY up.user_id, up.user_name, up.role ORDER BY unique_bin_count DESC LIMIT 11;

sub-database-3.158: SELECT SUM(albums.total_certified_copies * sales_by_country.exchange_rate) AS cumulative_sales_usd FROM albums JOIN sales_by_country ON albums.album_id = sales_by_country.album_id WHERE albums.artist_id = (SELECT artist_id FROM albums WHERE artist_title = 'Shania Twain') GROUP BY albums.album_title ORDER BY cumulative_sales_usd DESC;

sub-database-3.160: SELECT UPPER(albums.album_title) AS album_title_upper, SUM(sales_by_country.sales_volume) AS total_sales_volume, access_logs.access_date FROM albums LEFT JOIN sales_by_country ON albums.album_id = sales_by_country.album_id LEFT JOIN access_logs ON albums.album_id = access_logs.album_id GROUP BY albums.album_id;

sub-database-3.168: SELECT a.artist_name, a.album_title, a.genre, SUM(sc.sales_volume * sc.exchange_rate) AS total_standardized_sales, a.claimed_sales AS sales_rank FROM artists a JOIN albums al ON a.artist_id = al.artist_id JOIN sales_by_country sc ON al.album_id = sc.album_id WHERE al.claimed_sales > 1000000 GROUP BY a.artist_name, a.album_title, a.genre, a.claimed_sales ORDER BY total_standardized_sales + claimed_sales DESC LIMIT 6;

sub-database-3.170: SELECT T2.album_title, SUM(T1.sales_volume) AS cumulative_sales_volume FROM sales_by_country AS T1 JOIN albums AS T2 ON T1.album_id = T2.album_id WHERE T2.is_certified = 1 GROUP BY T2.album_title, T2.album_id ORDER BY cumulative_sales_volume DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.171: SELECT a.album_title, SUM(s.sales_volume) AS cumulative_sales_volume FROM albums a JOIN sales_by_country s ON a.album_id = s.album_id GROUP BY a.album_title, a.artist_id ORDER BY cumulative_sales_volume DESC;
sub-database-3.172: SELECT artists.artist_name, SUM(sales_by_country.sales_volume) AS cumulative_sales_volume FROM artists JOIN albums ON artists.artist_id = albums.artist_id JOIN sales_by_country ON albums.album_id = sales_by_country.album_id GROUP BY artists.artist_name ORDER BY cumulative_sales_volume DESC;
sub-database-3.173: SELECT a.album_id, a.album_title, a.release_year, a.total_certified_copies, COUNT(sc.sales_id) AS num_countries_sold, AVG(sc.exchange_rate) AS avg_exchange_rate FROM albums a JOIN sales_by_country sc ON a.album_id = sc.album_id GROUP BY a.album_id, a.album_title, a.release_year, a.total_certified_copies ORDER BY a.total_certified_copies DESC;

sub-database-3.178: SELECT s.superclass_name FROM superclasses s JOIN ( SELECT c.superclass, AVG(c.molecular_weight) as avg_molecular_weight FROM compounds c WHERE c.updated_at = ( SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM compounds WHERE compound_id IN ( SELECT compound_id FROM compound_access_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10 ) ) GROUP BY c.superclass ORDER BY avg_molecular_weight DESC LIMIT 6 ) m ON s.superclass_name = m.superclass ORDER BY m.avg_molecular_weight DESC;

sub-database-3.185: SELECT s.superclass_id, s.superclass_name, COUNT(c.compound_id) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cal.access_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cal.access_type = 'edit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS edit_count FROM superclasses s JOIN compounds c ON s.superclass_name = c.superclass JOIN compound_access_logs cal ON c.compound_id = cal.compound_id GROUP BY s.superclass_id, s.superclass_name;
sub-database-3.186: SELECT compound_id FROM compounds JOIN metrics ON compounds.compound_id = metrics.compound_id JOIN compound_access_logs ON compounds.compound_id = compound_access_logs.compound_id WHERE precision > 40.0 ORDER BY molecular_weight DESC, count DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.187: SELECT c.molecular_formula, MAX(cal.access_date), c.compound_id FROM compounds c JOIN compound_access_logs cal ON c.compound_id = cal.compound_id GROUP BY c.compound_id ORDER BY cal.count DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.188: SELECT c.compound_id, m.precision FROM compounds c JOIN metrics m ON c.compound_id = m.compound_id JOIN compound_access_logs cal ON c.compound_id = cal.compound_id WHERE m.precision > 0.4 AND cal.access_date = (SELECT MAX(access_date) FROM compound_access_logs WHERE compound_id = c.compound_id) ORDER BY (m.dice + m.dot_product + m.recall + m.precision) DESC;
sub-database-3.189: SELECT T3.superclass_name, SUM(T2.dice) AS cumulative_dice FROM metrics AS T2 JOIN compounds AS T1 ON T2.compound_id = T1.compound_id JOIN superclasses AS T3 ON T1.superclass = T3.superclass_name WHERE T1.count > 10 AND T1.recall > 0.75 GROUP BY T3.superclass_name ORDER BY T3.superclass_name ASC, cumulative_dice DESC
sub-database-3.190: SELECT superclass, SUM(dice * count) AS dice_cumulative, SUM(dot_product * count) AS dot_product_cumulative, SUM(recall * count) AS recall_cumulative, SUM(precision * count) AS precision_cumulative FROM compounds JOIN metrics ON compounds.compound_id = metrics.compound_id GROUP BY superclass;

sub-database-3.197: SELECT s.symbol, s.company_name, s.industry, s.market, s.ticker_exchange, s.currency, s.market_cap, sp.adj_close, sp.close, sp.high, sp.low, sp.open, sp.volume, sp.pre_market, sp.after_hours, sp.change_percent, sa.access_id, sa.access_date, sa.access_type, sa.ip_address, sa.user_agent, sa.duration, i.industry AS cumulative_industry_market_cap FROM stocks s JOIN stock_prices sp ON s.stock_id = sp.stock_id JOIN stock_activity sa ON s.stock_id = sa.stock_id JOIN industry i ON s.industry = i.industry WHERE sa.access_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31' AND sa.is_active = 1 ORDER BY s.industry, s.symbol;
sub-database-3.198: SELECT SUM(adj_close) AS total_adjusted_closing_price FROM stocks JOIN stock_prices ON stocks.stock_id = stock_prices.stock_id WHERE stocks.is_active = 1 AND stocks.source_accessed_by_analysts = 1
sub-database-3.199: SELECT s.stock_id, s.symbol, s.company_name, COUNT(DISTINCT v.user_id) AS unique_users, SUM(v.view_count) AS total_views, SUM(d.download_count) AS total_downloads, MAX(p.high) AS highest_price, MIN(p.low) AS lowest_price FROM stocks s JOIN views v ON s.stock_id = v.stock_id JOIN downloads d ON s.stock_id = d.stock_id JOIN stock_prices p ON s.stock_id = p.stock_id WHERE s.is_active = 1 GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.symbol, s.company_name ORDER BY total_views DESC LIMIT 1;

sub-database-3.202: SELECT trader_role, permission_level, SUM(stocks.market_cap) AS cumulative_market_cap FROM stocks JOIN stock_prices ON stocks.stock_id = stock_prices.stock_id WHERE stocks.industry = 'Technology' AND stocks.is_active = 1 GROUP BY trader_role, permission_level ORDER BY cumulative_market_cap ASC;

sub-database-3.208: SELECT symbol, AVG(volume) AS avg_volume_per_user FROM stocks JOIN stock_prices ON stocks.stock_id = stock_prices.stock_id WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY avg_volume_per_user DESC LIMIT 11

sub-database-3.210: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.role, s.symbol, AVG(sp.adj_close) AS avg_adj_close, MIN(sp.date) AS min_date, MAX(sp.date) AS max_date FROM users u JOIN user_roles ur ON u.role = ur.role_name JOIN stock_prices sp ON u.user_id = sp.stock_id JOIN stocks st ON sp.stock_id = st.stock_id GROUP BY u.user_id, s.symbol HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY u.user_id, avg_adj_close DESC LIMIT 3

sub-database-3.213: SELECT t.trade_type, c.symbol, MAX(t.trade_time) - MIN(t.trade_time) AS total_session_time FROM trades t JOIN cryptocurrencies c ON t.crypto_id = c.id GROUP BY t.user_id, t.trade_type, c.symbol ORDER BY total_session_time DESC LIMIT 1;

sub-database-3.216: SELECT u.user_id, u.username, SUM(t.quantity) AS total_trade_volume FROM users u JOIN trades t ON u.user_id = t.user_id JOIN cryptocurrencies c ON t.crypto_id = c.id WHERE c.id = 1 AND t.trade_time BETWEEN '2022-01-25' AND '2022-01-28' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username ORDER BY total_trade_volume DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.217: SELECT u.user_id, SUM(t.quantity) AS total_trading_volume FROM users u JOIN trades t ON u.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.status = 'completed' GROUP BY u.user_id ORDER BY total_trading_volume DESC
sub-database-3.218: SELECT u.username, c.name, SUM(t.quantity) AS cumulative_volume FROM users u JOIN trades t ON u.user_id = t.user_id JOIN cryptocurrencies c ON t.crypto_id = c.id GROUP BY u.username, c.name ORDER BY u.username, c.name
sub-database-3.219: SELECT u.username, u.profile, SUM(t.quantity * t.price) AS total_value, SUM(t.quantity) AS volume_traded, COUNT(t.trade_id) AS number_of_trades, COUNT(DISTINCT l.last_login) AS logins_last_month FROM users u JOIN trades t ON u.user_id = t.user_id JOIN order_history oh ON t.order_id = oh.order_id JOIN users u2 ON oh.user_id = u2.user_id LEFT JOIN login_log l ON u2.user_id = l.user_id WHERE l.login_time >= DATE('now', '-1 month') GROUP BY u.user_id ORDER BY SUM(t.quantity * t.price) DESC LIMIT 11;
sub-database-3.220: SELECT c.name, AVG(h.market_cap) AS avg_market_cap, COUNT(t.trade_id) AS num_trades_last_week FROM cryptocurrencies c JOIN trades t ON c.id = t.crypto_id JOIN historical_prices h ON c.id = h.crypto_id WHERE t.trade_time >= DATE('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(h.volume) DESC LIMIT 3
sub-database-3.221: SELECT u.user_id, u.username, s.session_id, SUM(t.quantity * t.price) AS total_profit_or_loss, COUNT(s.session_id) AS number_of_logins, AVG(s.session_duration) AS average_session_duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY u.user_id ORDER BY SUM(t.quantity * t.price) DESC) AS rank FROM users u JOIN trades t ON u.user_id = t.user_id JOIN user_sessions s ON u.user_id = s.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, s.session_id ORDER BY u.user_id, rank;

sub-database-3.223: SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.role, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.phone_number, u.address, u.created_at, u.last_login, u.status, t.trade_id, t.crypto_id, t.trade_type, t.quantity, t.price, t.trade_time, t.order_id, t.exchange, t.fees, t.status AS trade_status, ss.setting_id, ss.two_factor_enabled, ss.last_password_change, ss.last_2fa_login, ss.last_ip_address, ss.session_timeout, ak.api_key_id, ak.api_key, ak.created_at, ak.permissions, ak.last_used, ak.status AS api_key_status, us.session_id, us.login_time, us.logout_time, us.ip_address, us.device_type, us.device_id, us.session_duration FROM users u LEFT JOIN trades t ON u.user_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN security_settings ss ON u.user_id = ss.user_id LEFT JOIN api_keys ak ON u.user_id = ak.user_id LEFT JOIN user_sessions us ON u.user_id = us.user_id WHERE u.status = 'active'
sub-database-3.224: SELECT u.user_id, u.username, SUM(t.quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(t.price) AS average_price FROM users u JOIN order_history oh ON u.user_id = oh.user_id JOIN trades t ON oh.order_id = t.order_id WHERE oh.order_time >= '2022-11-28T00:00:00.000Z' AND oh.order_time <= '2022-11-28T06:00:00.000Z' AND t.trade_time >= '2022-11-28T00:00:00.000Z' AND t.trade_time <= '2022-11-28T06:00:00.000Z' AND u.user_id IN ( SELECT user_id FROM order_history WHERE order_time >= '2022-11-28T00:00:00.000Z' AND order_time <= '2022-11-28T06:00:00.000Z' INTERSECT SELECT user_id FROM trades WHERE trade_time >= '2022-11-28T00:00:00.000Z' AND trade_time <= '2022-11-28T06:00:00.000Z' ) GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username
sub-database-3.225: SELECT c.id AS crypto_id, (h.price - t.price) / t.price * 100 AS percentage_change FROM cryptocurrencies c JOIN trades t ON c.id = t.crypto_id JOIN historical_prices h ON c.id = h.crypto_id WHERE t.trade_time <= h.timestamp ORDER BY c.id
sub-database-3.226: SELECT u.username, c.name FROM users u JOIN trades t ON u.user_id = t.user_id JOIN cryptocurrencies c ON t.crypto_id = c.id GROUP BY u.user_id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN t.trade_type = 'sell' THEN t.quantity * t.price ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.trade_type = 'buy' THEN t.quantity * t.price ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1;

sub-database-3.229: SELECT trades.trade_time, trades.quantity FROM trades JOIN cryptocurrencies ON trades.crypto_id = cryptocurrencies.id JOIN order_history ON trades.order_id = order_history.order_id WHERE cryptocurrencies.id = 0 AND order_history.exchange = 'Binance'

sub-database-3.303: SELECT pt.test_id, pt.test_name, pt.created_at, COUNT(tl.log_id) AS log_count, MAX(pt.success_rate) AS success_rate FROM performance_tests pt LEFT JOIN test_logs tl ON pt.test_id = tl.test_id GROUP BY pt.test_id, pt.test_name, pt.created_at ORDER BY pt.test_id
sub-database-3.304: SELECT T3.system_name, T2.test_type_id, T2.test_name, AVG(T1.duration) AS avg_test_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN T1.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.result_id) AS success_rate, SUM(T1.error_count) AS total_errors, SUM(T1.read_speed) AS total_read_speed, SUM(T1.write_speed) AS total_write_speed, SUM(T1.throughput) AS total_throughput, COUNT(T4.log_id) AS num_log_entries FROM test_results T1 JOIN performance_tests T2 ON T1.test_id = T2.test_id JOIN storage_systems T3 ON T2.system_id = T3.system_id LEFT JOIN test_logs T4 ON T4.test_id = T2.test_id GROUP BY T3.system_name, T2.test_type_id, T2.test_name ORDER BY T3.system_name, T2.test_type_id, T2.test_name, total_throughput DESC;
sub-database-3.305: SELECT system_name, AVG(average_duration) AS avg_duration, MAX(read_speed) AS max_read_speed FROM storage_systems JOIN test_results_summary ON storage_systems.system_id = test_results_summary.system_id GROUP BY system_name ORDER BY system_name DESC, avg_duration DESC, max_read_speed DESC
sub-database-3.306: SELECT T1.system_id, T1.system_name, T1.description, T1.vendor, T1.model, T1.capacity, T2.success_rate FROM storage_systems AS T1 JOIN test_results_summary AS T2 ON T1.system_id = T2.system_id WHERE T2.success_rate > 50 ORDER BY T2.success_rate DESC
sub-database-3.307: SELECT performance_tests.test_name FROM performance_tests JOIN test_results_summary ON performance_tests.test_id = test_results_summary.test_id JOIN test_results ON test_results_summary.parameter_id = test_results.parameter_id JOIN test_notifications ON performance_tests.test_id = test_notifications.test_id WHERE test_results.io_allocation = (SELECT MAX(io_allocation) FROM test_results WHERE io_type = 'I/O allocation') AND test_notifications.notification_type = 'High I/O allocation detected'
sub-database-3.308: SELECT T2.system_name FROM performance_tests AS T1 JOIN storage_systems AS T2 ON T1.system_id = T2.system_id JOIN test_parameters AS T3 ON T1.test_id = T3.test_id JOIN test_results AS T4 ON T3.parameter_id = T4.parameter_id GROUP BY T2.system_name HAVING COUNT(T1.test_id) > 0 ORDER BY AVG(T4.duration) DESC LIMIT 1
sub-database-3.309: SELECT t2.test_id FROM performance_tests AS t2 JOIN test_results_summary AS t3 ON t2.test_id = t3.test_id WHERE t3.average_duration IN (SELECT average_duration FROM test_results_summary ORDER BY average_duration DESC LIMIT 6) UNION SELECT t2.test_id FROM performance_tests AS t2 JOIN test_notifications AS t4 ON t2.test_id = t4.test_id WHERE t4.notification_type = 'error' AND t4.status = 'sent'
sub-database-3.310: SELECT pt.test_id, pt.test_name, AVG(p.duration) AS avg_duration, MAX(p.duration) AS max_duration, AVG(p.io_allocation) AS avg_io_allocation, MAX(p.io_allocation) AS max_io_allocation, AVG(p.read_speed) AS avg_read_speed, MAX(p.read_speed) AS max_read_speed, AVG(p.write_speed) AS avg_write_speed, MAX(p.write_speed) AS max_write_speed, COUNT(p.error_encountered) AS error_count, sc.cache_policy, sc.raid_level, sc.config_details FROM performance_tests pt JOIN performance_results p ON pt.test_id = p.test_id JOIN system_configs sc ON pt.system_id = sc.system_id GROUP BY pt.test_id, sc.cache_policy, sc.raid_level, sc.config_details ORDER BY pt.test_id;
sub-database-3.311: SELECT u.created_by, s.system_id, p.test_name, AVG(tr.throughput) AS avg_throughput FROM performance_tests p JOIN test_results tr ON p.test_id = tr.parameter_id JOIN system_configs s ON p.system_id = s.system_id JOIN user_access ua ON p.test_id = ua.test_id GROUP BY u.created_by, s.system_id, p.test_name ORDER BY avg_throughput DESC LIMIT 4
sub-database-3.312: SELECT system_id, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(read_speed) AS avg_read_speed FROM test_results JOIN test_parameters ON test_results.parameter_id = test_parameters.parameter_id GROUP BY system_id ORDER BY avg_duration DESC;
sub-database-3.313: SELECT s.state_name, ag.age_range, gt.gender_type, SUM(pe.population) AS total_population, AVG(ds.median_income) AS average_median_income, AVG(ds.unemployment_rate) AS average_unemployment_rate FROM states s JOIN population_estimates pe ON s.state_id = pe.state_id JOIN demographic_summary ds ON s.state_id = ds.state_id JOIN age_groups ag ON ds.average_age BETWEEN ag.age_range_min AND ag.age_range_max JOIN genders gt ON ds.gender_type = gt.gender_type WHERE ds.year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM demographic_summary) GROUP BY s.state_name, ag.age_range, gt.gender_type ORDER BY s.state_name, ag.age_range, gt.gender_type
sub-database-3.314: SELECT s.state_name, d.total_population, d.average_age, d.gender_id, d.race_id, d.ethnicity_id, d.median_income, d.unemployment_rate, SUM(d.population) AS group_population, COUNT(d.population) AS group_count FROM states s JOIN demographic_summary d ON s.state_id = d.state_id GROUP BY s.state_name, d.gender_id, d.race_id, d.ethnicity_id ORDER BY s.state_name, d.total_population DESC;
sub-database-3.315: SELECT s.state_name, ag.age_range, g.gender_type, r.race_name, e.ethnicity_name, SUM(pe.population) OVER (PARTITION BY pe.state_id ORDER BY pe.year) AS cumulative_population, SUM(pe.population) AS total_population, AVG(pe.average_age) AS average_age, COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_data_accesses, MIN(al.access_time) AS first_access_time, MAX(al.access_time) AS last_access_time FROM demographic_summary ds JOIN states s ON ds.state_id = s.state_id JOIN population_estimates pe ON ds.state_id = pe.state_id AND ds.year = pe.year JOIN age_groups ag ON pe.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id JOIN gender_types g ON pe.gender_id = g.gender_id JOIN races r ON pe.race_id = r.race_id JOIN ethnicities e ON pe.ethnicity_id = e.ethnicity_id JOIN access_logs al ON ds.state_id = al.state_id AND ds.year = al.year GROUP BY s.state_name, ag.age_range, g.gender_type, r.race_name, e.ethnicity_name, ds.year ORDER BY ds.year;
sub-database-3.316: SELECT races.race_name FROM races JOIN demographic_summary ON races.race_id = demographic_summary.race_id JOIN states ON demographic_summary.state_id = states.state_id WHERE states.region IN ('Alabama', 'Alaska') AND demographic_summary.year IN (2013, 2016) GROUP BY races.race_name ORDER BY COUNT(demographic_summary.summary_id) DESC;
sub-database-3.317: SELECT s.state_name, ds.year, SUM(ds.total_population) AS cumulative_population FROM states s JOIN demographic_summary ds ON s.state_id = ds.state_id WHERE ds.year = 2013 AND (s.state_name = 'Alabama' OR s.state_name = 'Alaska') GROUP BY s.state_name, ds.year ORDER BY s.state_name, ds.year
sub-database-3.318: SELECT s.state_name, g.gender_type, a.age_range, SUM(pe.population) AS total_population FROM states s JOIN demographic_summary ds ON s.state_id = ds.state_id JOIN population_estimates pe ON ds.summary_id = pe.estimate_id JOIN genders g ON pe.gender_id = g.gender_id JOIN age_groups a ON pe.age_group_id = a.age_group_id WHERE ds.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2016 AND a.age_range = '0-4' GROUP BY s.state_name, g.gender_type, a.age_range;
sub-database-3.319: SELECT ds.state_id, SUM(ds.total_population) AS cumulative_population FROM demographic_summary ds JOIN states s ON ds.state_id = s.state_id JOIN access_logs al ON ds.state_id = al.state_id WHERE ds.state_id = 1 AND ds.year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2016 GROUP BY ds.state_id ORDER BY ds.year;
sub-database-3.320: SELECT s.state_name, r.race_name, a.age_range, g.gender_id, SUM(pe.population) AS cumulative_population FROM states s JOIN population_estimates pe ON s.state_id = pe.state_id JOIN races r ON pe.race_id = r.race_id JOIN age_groups a ON pe.age_group_id = a.age_group_id JOIN gender g ON pe.gender_id = g.gender_id GROUP BY s.state_name, r.race_name, a.age_range, g.gender_id ORDER BY s.state_name, r.race_name, a.age_range, g.gender_id;
sub-database-3.321: SELECT ds.state_id, ds.state_name, ds.total_population, ds.year, ds.average_age, ds.median_income, ds.unemployment_rate, pe.population AS total_population_estimate, SUM(al.total_accesses) AS cumulative_sum_of_total_accesses FROM demographic_summary ds LEFT JOIN population_estimates pe ON ds.state_id = pe.state_id AND ds.year = pe.year LEFT JOIN ( SELECT state_id, COUNT(*) AS total_accesses FROM access_logs GROUP BY state_id ) al ON ds.state_id = al.state_id GROUP BY ds.state_id, ds.state_name, ds.total_population, ds.year, ds.average_age, ds.median_income, ds.unemployment_rate, pe.population ORDER BY ds.total_population DESC;
sub-database-3.322: SELECT s.state_name, AVG(pe.population) AS avg_population, CASE WHEN AVG(pe.population) > (SELECT AVG(total_population) FROM demographic_summary WHERE year >= 2017) THEN 'Above' ELSE 'Below' END AS avg_above_overall FROM states s JOIN population_estimates pe ON s.state_id = pe.state_id WHERE pe.year >= 2017 GROUP BY s.state_name HAVING AVG(pe.population) > (SELECT AVG(total_population) FROM demographic_summary WHERE year >= 2017) ORDER BY AVG(pe.population) DESC;
sub-database-3.323: SELECT p.state_id, p.year, g.gender_type, r.race_name, e.ethnicity_id, SUM(p.population) AS cumulative_population FROM population_estimates p JOIN genders g ON p.gender_id = g.gender_id JOIN races r ON p.race_id = r.race_id JOIN states s ON p.state_id = s.state_id JOIN ethnicity e ON p.ethnicity_id = e.ethnicity_id GROUP BY p.state_id, p.year, g.gender_type, r.race_name, e.ethnicity_id ORDER BY p.state_id, p.year, g.gender_type, r.race_name, e.ethnicity_id;
sub-database-3.324: SELECT states.state_name, report_dates.year, SUM(population_estimates.population - p.previous_population) AS cumulative_population_change FROM states JOIN population_estimates ON states.state_id = population_estimates.state_id JOIN ( SELECT state_id, year, population, LAG(population) OVER (PARTITION BY state_id ORDER BY year) AS previous_population FROM population_estimates ) p ON states.state_id = p.state_id AND states.year = p.year GROUP BY states.state_name, report_dates.year ORDER BY states.state_name, report_dates.year
sub-database-3.325: SELECT p.age_group_id, AVG(p.data_quality_score) AS avg_data_quality_score FROM demographic_summary d JOIN population_estimates p ON d.state_id = p.state_id AND d.year = p.year JOIN states s ON d.state_id = s.state_id WHERE s.state_name = 'Alabama' AND d.year = 2022 AND p.year = 2022 GROUP BY p.age_group_id;
sub-database-3.326: SELECT s.state_name, s.region FROM states s JOIN demographic_summary d ON s.state_id = d.state_id WHERE d.year != (SELECT MAX(year) FROM demographic_summary) ORDER BY d.median_income DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.327: SELECT age_groups.age_range, genders.gender_type, ethnicities.ethnicity_name, demographic_summary.year, demographic_summary.last_updated FROM demographic_summary JOIN population_estimates ON demographic_summary.state_id = population_estimates.state_id JOIN age_groups ON population_estimates.age_group_id = age_groups.age_group_id JOIN genders ON population_estimates.gender_id = genders.gender_id JOIN ethnicities ON population_estimates.ethnicity_id = ethnicities.ethnicity_id WHERE demographic_summary.state_id = 1 ORDER BY demographic_summary.year, age_groups.age_group_order, genders.gender_order, ethnicities.ethnicity_order, demographic_summary.last_updated
sub-database-3.328: SELECT total_population FROM demographic_summary JOIN states ON demographic_summary.state_id = states.state_id WHERE states.abbreviation = 'AK' AND demographic_summary.year = (SELECT MIN(report_year) FROM report_dates)
sub-database-3.329: SELECT p.year, s.state_id, p.age_group_id, g.gender_id, r.race_id, e.ethnicity_id, SUM(p.population) AS cumulative_population FROM population_estimates p JOIN states st ON p.state_id = st.state_id JOIN genders g ON p.gender_id = g.gender_id JOIN races r ON p.race_id = r.race_id JOIN ethnicities e ON p.ethnicity_id = e.ethnicity_id WHERE p.state_id = 1 GROUP BY p.year, s.state_id, p.age_group_id, g.gender_id, r.race_id, e.ethnicity_id ORDER BY p.year ASC
sub-database-3.330: SELECT d.state_id, d.total_population, d.average_age, MAX(d.data_quality_score) AS average_data_quality, d.median_income, d.unemployment_rate, s.population_density, s.median_income AS state_median_income, s.unemployment_rate AS state_unemployment_rate, d.last_updated, COUNT(p.estimate_id) AS times_accessed, MAX(p.report_date) AS last_access_time FROM demographic_summary d JOIN states s ON d.state_id = s.state_id LEFT JOIN population_estimates p ON d.state_id = p.state_id AND d.year = p.year GROUP BY d.state_id, d.total_population, d.average_age, d.median_income, d.unemployment_rate, s.population_density, s.median_income, s.unemployment_rate, d.last_updated ORDER BY d.state_id;
sub-database-3.331: SELECT s.state_name FROM states s JOIN demographic_summary d ON s.state_id = d.state_id ORDER BY (d.total_population + d.median_income + d.population_density - d.unemployment_rate) DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.332: SELECT states.state_name, SUM(population_estimates.population) AS total_population FROM states JOIN population_estimates ON states.state_id = population_estimates.state_id JOIN races ON population_estimates.race_id = races.race_id JOIN ethnicity ON population_estimates.ethnicity_id = ethnicity.ethnicity_id JOIN genders ON population_estimates.gender_id = genders.gender_id WHERE races.race_name = 'Hispanic' AND genders.gender_name = 'Female' GROUP BY states.state_name, states.state_id ORDER BY SUM(population_estimates.population) DESC, states.year DESC
sub-database-3.333: SELECT d.state_id, s.state_name, MAX(d.year) AS latest_year, SUM(d.total_population) AS total_population_count FROM demographic_summary d JOIN states s ON d.state_id = s.state_id WHERE d.year >= 2013 GROUP BY d.state_id, s.state_name;
sub-database-3.334: SELECT state_name, report_year, SUM(total_population) AS cumulative_population FROM states JOIN demographic_summary ON states.state_id = demographic_summary.state_id WHERE report_year >= 2009 GROUP BY state_name, report_year ORDER BY state_name, report_year
sub-database-3.335: SELECT s.abbreviation, (p.total_population - p.min_population) AS cumulative_growth FROM states s JOIN ( SELECT state_id, MIN(year) AS min_year, MAX(year) AS max_year, total_population FROM demographic_summary GROUP BY state_id ) smin ON s.state_id = smin.state_id JOIN demographic_summary p ON s.state_id = p.state_id AND p.year = smin.max_year JOIN ( SELECT state_id, total_population FROM demographic_summary WHERE year = smin.min_year ) pm ON s.state_id = pm.state_id ORDER BY s.abbreviation
sub-database-3.336: SELECT states.state_name FROM demographic_summary JOIN states ON demographic_summary.state_id = states.state_id GROUP BY states.state_name ORDER BY AVG(demographic_summary.total_population) DESC LIMIT 1
sub-database-3.337: SELECT p.product_name, (sas.sales_count / ps.quantity) * 100 AS sales_percentage FROM products p JOIN product_sizes ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id JOIN size_analysis sas ON ps.product_id = sas.product_id AND ps.size_id = sas.size_id WHERE p.product_id IN ( SELECT product_id FROM size_analysis GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(sales_count) > 0 AND COUNT(ps.product_id) > 0 ) ORDER BY sales_percentage DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.338: SELECT T1.product_name, SUM(T2.quantity - T1.inventory_count) AS total_change FROM products AS T1 JOIN size_analysis AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id JOIN products_reviews AS T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.product_id WHERE T2.report_date = T3.review_date GROUP BY T1.product_name ORDER BY T1.product_name ASC;
sub-database-3.339: SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE product_id IN ( SELECT product_id FROM products_reviews WHERE rating > 0 ) AND product_id IN ( SELECT product_id FROM inventory_logs GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(change_amount) > 0 ) AND product_id IN ( SELECT product_id FROM inventory_logs ORDER BY change_date DESC LIMIT 3 ) AND product_id IN ( SELECT product_id FROM ( SELECT product_id, AVG(rating) as avg_rating FROM products_reviews GROUP BY product_id ) AS avg_reviews ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 3 )
sub-database-3.340: SELECT SUM(change_amount) AS cumulative_change, qc.status AS latest_qc_status, qc.date_checked AS latest_qc_date, AVG(pr.rating) AS average_rating FROM products p JOIN inventory_logs il ON p.product_id = il.product_id JOIN quality_control qc ON p.product_id = qc.product_id JOIN products_reviews pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE p.product_id = 1 GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY qc.date_checked DESC, pr.review_date DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.341: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(sa.sales_count) AS total_sales, AVG(pr.rating) AS avg_rating FROM products p JOIN size_analysis sa ON p.product_id = sa.product_id JOIN inventory_logs il ON p.product_id = il.product_id WHERE il.change_date >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY p.product_name, p.product_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC, SUM(il.change_amount) ASC
sub-database-3.342: SELECT ps.product_id, ps.size_id, SUM(sa.sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(ps.quantity + il.change_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.product_id, ps.size_id) AS cumulative_inventory, qc.status AS quality_control_status, COUNT(qc.qc_id) AS count_of_qc_status, AVG(pr.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(pr.review_id) AS total_count_of_reviews FROM product_sizes ps JOIN size_analysis sa ON ps.product_id = sa.product_id AND ps.size_id = sa.size_id JOIN quality_control qc ON ps.product_id = qc.product_id AND ps.size_id = qc.size_id JOIN products_reviews pr ON ps.product_id = pr.product_id LEFT JOIN inventory_logs il ON ps.product_id = il.product_id AND ps.size_id = il.size_id WHERE ps.product_id = 1 AND ps.size_id = 1 GROUP BY ps.product_id, ps.size_id, qc.status ORDER BY total_sales DESC, cumulative_inventory ASC
sub-database-3.343: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, AVG(qc.status) AS health_score, SUM(sa.sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(il.change_amount) AS net_inventory_change FROM products p JOIN quality_control qc ON p.product_id = qc.product_id JOIN size_analysis sa ON p.product_id = sa.product_id JOIN inventory_logs il ON p.product_id = il.product_id AND sa.size_id = il.size_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name;
sub-database-3.344: SELECT p.inventory_count + SUM(il.change_amount) - sa.sales_count AS final_quantity FROM products p JOIN product_sizes ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id LEFT JOIN inventory_logs il ON p.product_id = il.product_id AND ps.size_id = il.size_id LEFT JOIN size_analysis sa ON p.product_id = sa.product_id AND ps.size_id = sa.size_id WHERE p.product_id = 1 AND ps.size_id = 0 GROUP BY p.product_id, ps.size_id;
sub-database-3.345: SELECT pa.product_id, pa.size_id, SUM(pa.sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(il.change_amount) AS total_inventory_change, MAX(pa.report_date) AS latest_report_date, MAX(il.change_date) AS latest_inventory_change_date FROM size_analysis pa JOIN inventory_logs il ON pa.product_id = il.product_id AND pa.size_id = il.size_id WHERE pa.report_date <= il.change_date GROUP BY pa.product_id, pa.size_id HAVING total_sales > 0 AND total_inventory_change <> 0;
sub-database-3.346: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(sa.sales_count) AS total_sales, qc.status AS latest_quality_control_status FROM products p JOIN product_sizes ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id JOIN size_analysis sa ON ps.size_id = sa.size_id AND ps.product_id = sa.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MAX(report_date) AS max_report_date FROM size_analysis GROUP BY product_id ) saa ON sa.product_id = saa.product_id AND sa.report_date = saa.max_report_date LEFT JOIN quality_control qc ON sa.product_id = qc.product_id AND saa.max_report_date = qc.report_date GROUP BY p.product_name, qc.status ORDER BY total_sales DESC, p.product_name ASC
sub-database-3.347: SELECT p.product_name, s.size_label FROM products p JOIN product_sizes ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id JOIN sizes sz ON ps.size_id = sz.size_id JOIN size_analysis sa ON p.product_id = sa.product_id AND ps.size_id = sa.size_id WHERE sa.sales_count > 10 GROUP BY ps.size_id ORDER BY SUM(sa.sales_count) DESC LIMIT 4
sub-database-3.348: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(sa.sales_count) AS cumulative_sales FROM products p JOIN product_sizes ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id JOIN size_analysis sa ON ps.size_id = sa.size_id AND p.product_id = sa.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY cumulative_sales DESC
sub-database-3.349: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(s.sales_count) AS total_sales, AVG(i.change_amount) AS avg_inventory_change, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_customer_satisfaction FROM products p JOIN size_analysis s ON p.product_id = s.product_id JOIN inventory_logs i ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN products_reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY (total_sales + avg_inventory_change + avg_customer_satisfaction) DESC LIMIT 10;
sub-database-3.350: SELECT products.product_name FROM products JOIN size_analysis ON products.product_id = size_analysis.product_id JOIN quality_control ON products.product_id = quality_control.product_id JOIN products_reviews ON products.product_id = products_reviews.product_id JOIN inventory_logs ON products.product_id = inventory_logs.product_id WHERE size_analysis.report_date >= '2024-01-01' AND quality_control.date_checked >= '2024-01-01' AND products_reviews.review_date >= '2024-01-01' AND inventory_logs.change_date >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY ((size_analysis.sales_count * products.price) / products.inventory_count) - ((SELECT SUM(change_amount) FROM inventory_logs WHERE product_id = products.product_id AND change_date >= '2024-01-01') / COUNT(products.product_id)) DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.351: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, SUM(sales.quantity_sold) AS sales_count, il.change_date AS last_inventory_change_date, qc.date_checked AS last_qc_date, qcs.status AS qc_status, AVG(pr.rating) AS avg_review_rating FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity_sold) AS quantity_sold FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) sales ON p.product_id = sales.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, MAX(date_checked) AS date_checked FROM quality_control GROUP BY product_id) qc ON p.product_id = qc.product_id LEFT JOIN quality_control qcs ON qc.product_id = qcs.product_id AND qc.date_checked = qcs.date_checked LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, size_id, MAX(change_date) AS change_date FROM inventory_logs GROUP BY product_id, size_id) il ON p.product_id = il.product_id WHERE sales_count > 0 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, il.size_id ORDER BY il.size_id, sales_count DESC, avg_review_rating DESC;
sub-database-3.352: SELECT p.product_name, s.size_label, SUM(sa.sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(il.change_amount) AS cumulative_inventory_changes FROM products p JOIN product_sizes ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id JOIN sizes s ON ps.size_id = s.size_id LEFT JOIN size_analysis sa ON ps.product_id = sa.product_id AND ps.size_id = sa.size_id LEFT JOIN inventory_logs il ON ps.product_id = il.product_id AND ps.size_id = il.size_id GROUP BY p.product_name, s.size_label ORDER BY p.product_name, s.size_label
sub-database-3.353: SELECT s.size_label, SUM(ps.quantity) AS total_items_sold FROM product_sizes ps JOIN sizes s ON ps.size_id = s.size_id LEFT JOIN size_analysis sa ON ps.product_id = sa.product_id AND ps.size_id = sa.size_id LEFT JOIN inventory_logs il ON ps.product_id = il.product_id AND ps.size_id = il.size_id WHERE sa.report_date >= '2023-01-01' AND il.change_date <= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY s.size_label ORDER BY s.length ASC
sub-database-3.354: SELECT ps.size_id, ps.product_id, sa.sales_count, il.change_date, il.change_amount FROM product_sizes ps JOIN size_analysis sa ON ps.product_id = sa.product_id AND ps.size_id = sa.size_id JOIN inventory_logs il ON ps.size_id = il.size_id AND ps.product_id = il.product_id WHERE ps.size_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT size_id FROM product_sizes WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE category_id = 'pants')) ORDER BY ps.size_id, il.change_date DESC;
sub-database-3.355: SELECT ps.size_id, sa.sales_count, AVG(il.change_amount) AS avg_inventory_change, AVG(pr.rating) AS avg_rating FROM product_sizes ps JOIN size_analysis sa ON ps.product_id = sa.product_id AND ps.size_id = sa.size_id AND sa.report_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31' JOIN inventory_logs il ON ps.size_id = il.size_id AND il.change_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31' JOIN products_reviews pr ON ps.product_id = pr.product_id AND pr.review_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31' GROUP BY ps.size_id ORDER BY ps.size_id;
sub-database-3.356: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(sa.sales_count) AS total_sales_count FROM products p JOIN product_sizes ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id JOIN size_analysis sa ON ps.size_id = sa.size_id AND p.product_id = sa.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_sales_count DESC
sub-database-3.357: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, s.size_id, s.quantity AS current_inventory, SUM(sa.sales_count) AS cumulative_sales, qc.status, COUNT(CASE WHEN qc.status = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(qc.qc_id) * 100 AS pass_rate, COUNT(CASE WHEN qc.status = 'Fail' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(qc.qc_id) * 100 AS fail_rate, AVG(pr.rating) AS average_rating FROM products p JOIN product_sizes s ON p.product_id = s.product_id AND s.size_id = 1 LEFT JOIN size_analysis sa ON p.product_id = sa.product_id AND sa.size_id = 1 AND sa.report_date = '2024-09-01' LEFT JOIN quality_control qc ON p.product_id = qc.product_id AND qc.size_id = 1 LEFT JOIN products_reviews pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id AND pr.size_id = 1 WHERE sa.sales_count > 0 AND pr.rating > 3 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, s.size_id;
