sub-database-3.600: SELECT t.team_name, l.league_name, s.season_name, t.goals_for AS total_goals_scored, t.goals_against AS total_goals_conceded, t.wins, t.losses, t.draws, (t.goals_for - t.goals_against) AS goal_difference, COUNT(m.match_id) AS total_matches_played, SUM(p.goals_scored) AS total_goals_scored_by_players, SUM(p.assists) AS total_assists_by_players, SUM(p.yellow_cards) AS total_yellow_cards_by_players, SUM(p.red_cards) AS total_red_cards_by_players FROM teams t JOIN leagues l ON t.league_id = l.league_id JOIN seasons s ON t.season_id = s.season_id LEFT JOIN players p ON t.team_id = p.team_id LEFT JOIN matches m ON (t.team_id = m.home_team_id OR t.team_id = m.away_team_id) GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name, l.league_name, s.season_name ORDER BY t.goals_for DESC;
sub-database-3.601: SELECT T1.team_name FROM teams AS T1 JOIN match_statistics AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.home_team_id OR T1.team_id = T2.away_team_id JOIN matches AS T3 ON T2.match_id = T3.match_id WHERE T1.league_id = (SELECT league_id FROM leagues WHERE league_name = 'La Liga') ORDER BY (T2.home_team_long_passes + T2.away_team_long_passes) DESC, (T2.home_team_shots_on_target + T2.away_team_shots_on_target) DESC, (T2.home_team_corners_taken + T2.away_team_corners_taken) DESC;
sub-database-3.602: SELECT T1.home_team_id, T1.away_team_id, AVG(T2.home_goals + T2.away_goals) AS avg_total_goals FROM matches AS T2 JOIN teams AS T1 ON T2.home_team_id = T1.team_id OR T2.away_team_id = T1.team_id WHERE T2.match_type_id = 1 GROUP BY T1.home_team_id, T1.away_team_id ORDER BY avg_total_goals ASC;
sub-database-3.603: SELECT t.team_name, t.goals_for, p.player_name, p.goals_scored + p.assists AS total_contributions FROM teams t JOIN ( SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, SUM(home_goals) AS goals_for FROM matches WHERE season_id = 1 GROUP BY home_team_id ORDER BY goals_for DESC LIMIT 4 UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id AS team_id, SUM(away_goals) AS goals_for FROM matches WHERE season_id = 1 GROUP BY away_team_id ORDER BY goals_for DESC LIMIT 4 ) m ON t.team_id = m.team_id JOIN players p ON t.team_id = p.team_id WHERE t.season_id = 1 GROUP BY p.player_id ORDER BY t.goals_for DESC, p.total_contributions DESC LIMIT 6;
sub-database-3.604: SELECT T1.team_name FROM teams AS T1 JOIN match_statistics AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.home_team_id WHERE T2.match_result = 'H' GROUP BY T1.team_name ORDER BY AVG(T1.points - (SELECT SUM(home_goals) - SUM(away_goals) FROM matches WHERE home_team_id = T1.team_id AND match_result = 'H')) DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.605: SELECT T1.team_name, T1.goals_for AS total_goals_scored, T1.points AS ranking FROM teams AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.home_team_id OR T1.team_id = T2.away_team_id GROUP BY T1.team_name, T1.team_id ORDER BY total_goals_scored DESC;
sub-database-3.606: SELECT t.season_id, t.team_name, t.points, SUM(t.goals_for + ms.away_team_long_passes) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(t.goals_against + ms.home_team_long_passes) AS total_goals_conceded, t.points AS total_points, SUM(t.wins) AS total_home_wins, SUM(ms.away_team_wins) AS total_away_wins, COUNT(m.match_id) AS total_matches_played, AVG(ms.home_team_long_passes) AS avg_long_passes_per_match, AVG(ms.home_team_short_passes) AS avg_short_passes_per_match, AVG(ms.home_team_shots_on_target) AS avg_shots_on_target_per_match, AVG(ms.home_team_shots_off_target) AS avg_shots_off_target_per_match, AVG(ms.home_team_corners_taken) AS avg_corners_taken_per_match, AVG(ms.home_team_offsides) AS avg_offsides_committed_per_match FROM teams t JOIN matches m ON t.team_id = m.home_team_id JOIN match_statistics ms ON m.match_id = ms.match_id GROUP BY t.season_id, t.team_name ORDER BY t.points DESC LIMIT 4;
sub-database-3.607: SELECT t.team_name, (t.home_team_long_passes - t.away_team_long_passes) AS net_long_passes, (t.home_team_long_passes - t.away_team_long_passes) - (t.home_team_short_passes - t.away_team_short_passes) - (t.home_team_shots_on_target - t.away_team_shots_on_target) - (t.home_team_shots_off_target - t.away_team_shots_off_target) - (t.home_team_corners_taken - t.away_team_corners_taken) - (t.home_team_offsides - t.away_team_offsides) AS diff FROM ( SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, home_team_long_passes - away_team_long_passes AS home_team_long_passes, home_team_short_passes - away_team_short_passes AS home_team_short_passes, home_team_shots_on_target - away_team_shots_on_target AS home_team_shots_on_target, home_team_shots_off_target - away_team_shots_off_target AS home_team_shots_off_target, home_team_corners_taken - away_team_corners_taken AS home_team_corners_taken, home_team_offsides - away_team_offsides AS home_team_offsides FROM match_statistics UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id AS team_id, away_team_long_passes - home_team_long_passes AS home_team_long_passes, away_team_short_passes - home_team_short_passes AS home_team_short_passes, away_team_shots_on_target - home_team_shots_on_target AS home_team_shots_on_target, away_team_shots_off_target - home_team_shots_off_target AS home_team_shots_off_target, away_team_corners_taken - home_team_corners_taken AS home_team_corners_taken, away_team_offsides - home_team_offsides AS home_team_offsides FROM match_statistics ) stats JOIN teams t ON stats.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.608: SELECT T2.team_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T1.season_id ORDER BY T1.goals_for DESC) AS rank FROM teams AS T1 JOIN leagues AS T3 ON T1.league_id = T3.league_id JOIN seasons AS T4 ON T1.season_id = T4.season_id JOIN players AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id GROUP BY T2.team_name, T1.season_id ORDER BY T1.season_id, rank;
sub-database-3.609: SELECT MAX(T1.goals_for) AS highest_total_goals FROM teams AS T1 JOIN leagues AS L ON T1.league_id = L.league_id WHERE T1.team_name = 'Liverpool' AND L.country = 'England'
sub-database-3.610: SELECT T1.team_name, T1.points FROM teams AS T1 JOIN leagues AS L ON T1.league_id = L.league_id JOIN seasons AS S ON T1.season_id = S.season_id WHERE L.league_name = 'league 1' AND S.season_name = 'season 1' ORDER BY T1.points DESC
sub-database-3.611: SELECT m.match_id, mt.match_type_name, SUM(ms.home_team_long_passes + ms.away_team_long_passes + ms.home_team_short_passes + ms.away_team_short_passes + ms.home_team_shots_on_target + ms.away_team_shots_on_target + ms.home_team_shots_off_target + ms.away_team_shots_off_target) AS cumulative_total_shots FROM matches m JOIN match_types mt ON m.match_type_id = mt.match_type_id JOIN match_statistics ms ON m.match_id = ms.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, mt.match_type_name ORDER BY m.match_id;
sub-database-3.612: SELECT ct.call_type_name, cr.resource_type, cr.battalion, AVG(cr.delay) AS avg_response_time FROM calls c JOIN call_types ct ON c.call_type = ct.call_type_code JOIN incident_resources cr ON c.incident_number = cr.incident_number WHERE ct.is_emergency = 1 GROUP BY ct.call_type_name, cr.resource_type, cr.battalion ORDER BY avg_response_time ASC
sub-database-3.613: SELECT calls.call_number, calls.call_date, calls.unit_id AS unit_name, calls.call_final_disposition, (calls.response_time - priorities.priority_response_time) AS response_efficiency, (calls.delay - (SELECT AVG(delay) FROM calls GROUP BY call_type)) AS delay_efficiency FROM calls JOIN priorities ON calls.priority = priorities.priority_id WHERE calls.call_date LIKE '2001%' ORDER BY response_efficiency + delay_efficiency DESC;
sub-database-3.614: SELECT ct.call_type_name, pr.priority_name, AVG(c.delay) AS avg_delay, AVG(c.call_duration) AS avg_call_duration, COUNT(c.call_number) AS total_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN c.delay > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_calls, (SUM(CASE WHEN c.delay > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.call_number)) AS delayed_calls_percentage FROM calls c JOIN call_types ct ON c.call_type = ct.call_type_name JOIN priorities pr ON c.priority = pr.priority_id GROUP BY ct.call_type_name, pr.priority_name ORDER BY ct.call_type_name, pr.priority_name;
sub-database-3.615: SELECT p.priority_id, p.priority_name, AVG(c.delay) AS avg_response_time FROM calls c JOIN priorities p ON c.priority = p.priority_id GROUP BY p.priority_id, p.priority_name UNION ALL SELECT 'overall', 'Overall', AVG(c.delay) AS avg_response_time FROM calls c
sub-database-3.616: SELECT SUM(incident_resources.resource_cost) AS total_cost FROM calls JOIN priorities ON calls.priority = priorities.priority_id JOIN incident_resources ON calls.incident_number = incident_resources.incident_number WHERE priorities.priority_name = 'high'
sub-database-3.617: SELECT c.call_number, c.battalion, c.priority, c.final_priority, c.call_date, c.available_datetime, c.delay, c.call_duration, ir.response_id, ir.response_time, ir.arrival_time, ir.departure_time, ir.response_outcome FROM calls c JOIN incident_responses ir ON c.incident_number = ir.incident_number WHERE c.is_emergency = 1 AND c.priority = (SELECT MAX(priority) FROM calls WHERE is_emergency = 1) ORDER BY c.call_date, c.available_datetime
sub-database-3.618: SELECT u.unit_id, u.unit_name, MIN(p.priority) AS min_severity, AVG(c.delay) AS avg_delay FROM calls c JOIN incident_responses ir ON c.incident_number = ir.incident_number JOIN units u ON ir.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN priorities p ON c.priority = p.priority_id GROUP BY u.unit_id, u.unit_name
sub-database-3.619: SELECT u.unit_id AS 'Unit 0', SUM(c.delay) AS total_response_time FROM units u JOIN incident_responses ir ON u.unit_id = ir.unit_id JOIN calls c ON ir.incident_number = c.incident_number GROUP BY u.unit_id ORDER BY total_response_time DESC
sub-database-3.620: SELECT calls.incident_number, AVG(julianday(calls.available_datetime) - julianday(incident_responses.departure_time)) AS avg_time_gap FROM calls JOIN incident_responses ON calls.incident_number = incident_responses.incident_number WHERE calls.priority = 1 GROUP BY calls.incident_number;
sub-database-3.621: SELECT i.incident_type, AVG(ir.response_time) AS avg_response_time, MAX(ir.response_time) AS max_response_time, SUM(ir.resource_cost) AS total_cost FROM incidents i JOIN incident_responses ir ON i.incident_number = ir.incident_number WHERE ir.response_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.incident_type ORDER BY avg_response_time DESC, i.incident_type;
sub-database-3.622: SELECT ct.final_priority, pr.priority_name, CASE WHEN delay BETWEEN 0 AND 15 THEN '0-15分钟' WHEN delay BETWEEN 16 AND 30 THEN '16-30分钟' WHEN delay BETWEEN 31 AND 45 THEN '31-45分钟' ELSE '46分钟以上' END AS time_bucket, AVG(delay) AS avg_response_time FROM calls c JOIN incident_responses ir ON c.incident_number = ir.incident_number JOIN call_types ct ON c.call_type = ct.call_type_code JOIN priorities pr ON c.priority = pr.priority_id WHERE c.call_date LIKE '2001-%' GROUP BY ct.final_priority, pr.priority_name, time_bucket;
sub-database-3.623: SELECT s.station_name, COUNT(i.incident_number) AS total_incidents, AVG(i.response_time) AS avg_response_time FROM stations s JOIN incident_responses i ON s.station_id = i.unit_id GROUP BY s.station_name ORDER BY total_incidents DESC, avg_response_time ASC LIMIT 10;
sub-database-3.624: SELECT battalion, unit_name, SUM(num_calls) AS total_calls, AVG(delay) AS adjusted_response_delay FROM ( SELECT u.battalion, u.unit_name, COUNT(ir.response_id) AS num_calls, c.delay FROM units u JOIN incident_responses ir ON u.unit_id = ir.unit_id JOIN calls c ON u.unit_id = c.unit_id GROUP BY u.battalion, u.unit_name, c.delay ) GROUP BY battalion, unit_name ORDER BY adjusted_response_delay DESC
sub-database-3.625: SELECT AVG(calls.delay) AS average_delay FROM calls JOIN units ON calls.unit_id = units.unit_id JOIN priorities ON calls.priority = priorities.priority_id WHERE units.battalion = '10' AND units.unit_status = 'en route' AND calls.call_type = 'structure fire'
sub-database-3.626: SELECT incidents.incident_type, AVG(CAST(strftime('%s', incident_responses.arrival_time) - strftime('%s', incidents.start_date) AS INTEGER)) / COUNT(*) AS avg_response_time FROM incidents JOIN incident_responses ON incidents.incident_number = incident_responses.incident_number GROUP BY incidents.incident_type ORDER BY avg_response_time ASC;
sub-database-3.627: SELECT battalion FROM calls JOIN units ON calls.unit_id = units.unit_id WHERE call_date = '2001-01-11' AND call_final_disposition = 'Other' AND delay IS NOT NULL GROUP BY battalion ORDER BY AVG(delay) DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.628: SELECT ct.call_type_name, ir.unit_id, u.unit_name, MAX(c.delay) AS max_delay FROM calls c JOIN incident_responses ir ON c.incident_number = ir.incident_number JOIN units u ON ir.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN call_types ct ON c.call_type = ct.call_type_name WHERE c.call_date LIKE '2001%' GROUP BY ct.call_type_name, ir.unit_id, u.unit_name ORDER BY ct.call_type_name, max_delay DESC;
sub-database-3.629: SELECT u.unit_name, COUNT(ir.response_id) AS total_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.response_outcome = 'successful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_responses, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ir.response_outcome = 'successful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(ir.response_id) * 100 AS success_rate FROM units u JOIN incident_responses ir ON u.unit_id = ir.unit_id JOIN calls c ON ir.incident_number = c.incident_number WHERE c.battalion = '0' GROUP BY u.unit_name ORDER BY successful_responses DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.630: SELECT ir.incident_number, ir.start_date, SUM(julianday(ir.arrival_time) - julianday(ir.response_time)) * 24 * 60 AS cumulative_delays FROM incidents inc JOIN incident_responses ir ON inc.incident_number = ir.incident_number GROUP BY ir.incident_number, ir.start_date ORDER BY ir.incident_number, ir.start_date
sub-database-3.631: SELECT SUM(incident_resources.resource_cost) AS total_resource_cost FROM incident_resources JOIN calls ON incident_resources.incident_number = calls.incident_number JOIN call_types ON calls.call_type = call_types.call_type_name JOIN incident_responses ON incident_resources.incident_number = incident_responses.incident_number WHERE call_types.call_type_name = '1' AND calls.call_final_disposition = 'Other' AND incident_responses.response_outcome = 'successful'
sub-database-3.632: SELECT calls.unit_type, AVG(CASE WHEN calls.als_unit = 'ALS' THEN calls.delay ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN calls.als_unit != 'ALS' THEN calls.delay ELSE NULL END) AS avg_diff_response_time FROM calls GROUP BY calls.unit_type
sub-database-3.633: SELECT n.neighborhood_name, n.neighborhood_risk_level, COUNT(i.incident_number) AS total_incidents, AVG(c.delay) AS average_response_delay, n.neighborhood_id, COUNT(s.station_id) AS number_of_units FROM calls c JOIN neighborhoods n ON c.neighborhood = n.neighborhood_name JOIN stations s ON c.unit_id = s.station_id WHERE c.delay IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.neighborhood_name, n.neighborhood_risk_level, n.neighborhood_id, s.station_id ORDER BY AVG(c.delay) DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.634: SELECT u.unit_id, u.unit_name, c.fire_prevention_district, AVG(ir.response_time) AS avg_response_time, p.priority_response_time, CASE WHEN AVG(ir.response_time) <= p.priority_response_time THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS response_time_label FROM units u JOIN calls c ON u.unit_id = c.unit_id JOIN incident_responses ir ON u.unit_id = ir.unit_id JOIN priorities p ON c.fire_prevention_district = p.priority_id GROUP BY u.unit_id, u.unit_name, c.fire_prevention_district HAVING COUNT(ir.response_id) > 0 ORDER BY c.fire_prevention_district, avg_response_time;
sub-database-3.635: SELECT el.education_level, dt.degree_type FROM education_levels el JOIN (SELECT education, degree_type, AVG(log_wage) AS avg_log_wage FROM individuals GROUP BY education, degree_type ORDER BY education, avg_log_wage DESC LIMIT 3 ) i ON el.education_id = i.education
sub-database-3.636: SELECT i.person_id, i.employment_status, AVG(jl.employment_status) AS avg_employment_status, COUNT(i.survey_date) AS total_entries FROM individuals i JOIN access_logs jl ON i.person_id = jl.user_id GROUP BY i.person_id, i.employment_status, jl.access_date ORDER BY i.person_id, jl.access_date;
sub-database-3.637: SELECT i.person_id, i.education, i.ability, fb.parental_marital_status, fb.parental_employment_status, (i.log_wage + i.mother_ed + i.father_ed + fb.family_income) AS adjusted_wage FROM individuals i JOIN family_backgrounds fb ON i.person_id = fb.family_id WHERE fb.parental_marital_status = 'married' AND fb.parental_employment_status = 'employed'
sub-database-3.638: SELECT ability_score, AVG(log_wage) AS avg_wage FROM individuals WHERE employment_status = 'employed' GROUP BY ability_score ORDER BY avg_wage DESC;
sub-database-3.639: SELECT AVG(T1.log_wage) AS avg_wage, T2.education_level FROM individuals AS T1 JOIN education_levels AS T2 ON T1.education = T2.eduction_id WHERE T1.gender = 'Female' AND T1.employment_status = 'Employed' GROUP BY T2.education_level ORDER BY avg_wage DESC LIMIT 6
sub-database-3.640: SELECT e.education_level, i.ability, AVG(i.log_wage) AS avg_cumulative_log_wage FROM individuals i JOIN education_levels e ON i.education = e.education_id WHERE i.survey_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY e.education_level, i.ability
sub-database-3.641: SELECT individuals.user_id, individuals.user_name, individuals.log_wage * (CASE WHEN individuals.education > 2 THEN 1.1 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN individuals.marital_status = 'married' THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN individuals.employment_status = 'employed' THEN 1.3 ELSE 1 END) AS adjusted_avg_log_wage FROM individuals JOIN access_logs ON individuals.person_id = access_logs.user_id JOIN reports ON individuals.person_id = reports.user_id WHERE individuals.survey_date >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY individuals.user_id, individuals.user_name, individuals.log_wage ORDER BY adjusted_avg_log_wage DESC LIMIT 1;
sub-database-3.642: SELECT individuals.person_id, MAX(individuals.log_wage * individuals.current_age) AS max_cumulative_log_wage FROM individuals WHERE individuals.current_age > 20 AND individuals.log_wage > 0 GROUP BY individuals.person_id
sub-database-3.643: SELECT i.person_id, AVG(fb.family_income) AS avg_family_income, fb.siblings, AVG(i.ability) AS avg_ability_score FROM individuals i JOIN family_backgrounds fb ON i.mother_ed = fb.mother_ed AND i.father_ed = fb.father_ed GROUP BY i.person_id ORDER BY avg_family_income DESC LIMIT 11
sub-database-3.644: SELECT e.education_level, AVG(i.log_wage) AS avg_wage, SUM(i.potential_experience) AS total_experience FROM individuals i JOIN education_levels e ON i.education = e.education_id GROUP BY e.education_level;
sub-database-3.645: SELECT AVG(i.log_wage - j.log_wage) AS avg_difference FROM individuals i JOIN family_backgrounds f ON i.mother_ed = f.mother_ed AND i.father_ed = f.father_ed JOIN ( SELECT education, marital_status, employment_status FROM individuals WHERE marital_status = 'married' AND employment_status = 'employed' ) subq ON i.education = subq.education WHERE i.marital_status = 'married' AND i.employment_status = 'employed'
sub-database-3.646: SELECT T1.education, T1.avg_log_wage FROM ( SELECT education, AVG(log_wage) AS avg_log_wage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY education ORDER BY AVG(log_wage) DESC) AS rn FROM individuals WHERE education IN ( SELECT education_id FROM education_levels ) GROUP BY education ) T1 JOIN ( SELECT education_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM individuals GROUP BY education_id ) T2 ON T1.education = T2.education_id WHERE T1.rn <= 1 AND T1.cnt >= 11 ORDER BY T1.avg_log_wage DESC
sub-database-3.647: SELECT e.education_level, AVG(i.log_wage) AS avg_log_wage FROM individuals i JOIN education_levels e ON i.education = e.education_id WHERE i.mother_ed >= 12 AND i.father_ed >= 12 AND (i.job_title LIKE '%Manager%' OR i.job_title LIKE '%Engineer%') AND (i.employment_status = 'employed' OR i.employment_status = 'self-employed') AND i.industry IN ('Technology', 'Education') AND i.siblings <= 2 AND i.survey_date BETWEEN '1999-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' GROUP BY e.education_level;
sub-database-3.648: SELECT i.person_id, i.education, i.log_wage, i.mother_ed, i.father_ed, fb.family_income FROM individuals i JOIN family_backgrounds fb ON i.mother_ed = fb.mother_ed AND i.father_ed = fb.father_ed ORDER BY i.update_date DESC
sub-database-3.649: SELECT i.person_id, i.log_wage, AVG(i.log_wage) OVER(PARTITION BY i.education) AS avg_log_wage FROM individuals i JOIN education_levels el ON i.education = el.education_id JOIN family_backgrounds fb ON i.mother_ed = fb.family_id AND i.father_ed = fb.family_id WHERE i.education IN (SELECT education FROM individuals WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM (SELECT rowid, education, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY education ORDER BY log_wage DESC) as rn FROM individuals) WHERE rn <= 11)) GROUP BY i.person_id, i.education ORDER BY avg_log_wage DESC LIMIT 21
sub-database-3.650: SELECT i.person_id, i.education, i.log_wage, i.ability, d.dataset_name, d.description, d.created_by FROM individuals i JOIN reports r ON i.person_id = r.user_id JOIN datasets d ON r.dataset_id = d.dataset_id WHERE i.survey_date = ( SELECT MAX(survey_date) FROM individuals WHERE person_id = i.person_id ) ORDER BY i.person_id;
sub-database-3.651: SELECT i.person_id, i.user_id, i.employment_status, i.siblings, i.log_wage, i.potential_experience FROM individuals i JOIN family_backgrounds f ON i.user_id = f.user_id WHERE i.siblings > 0 AND i.employment_status = 'employed' AND f.siblings > 0 AND log(i.log_wage * i.potential_experience) > 0
sub-database-3.652: SELECT r.dataset_id, AVG(i.log_wage) AS avg_log_wage FROM reports r JOIN individuals i ON r.user_id = i.person_id WHERE r.employment_rate > 70 GROUP BY r.dataset_id ORDER BY r.dataset_id LIMIT 11;
sub-database-3.653: SELECT education, SUM(log_wage) AS cumulative_log_wage FROM individuals GROUP BY education ORDER BY potential_experience;
sub-database-3.654: SELECT education_level, AVG(log_wage) AS avg_log_wage FROM individuals JOIN education_levels ON individuals.education = education_levels.education_id WHERE log_wage > LOG(2.0) AND potential_experience > 4 GROUP BY education_level;
sub-database-3.655: SELECT e.education_level, i.person_id, i.ability, i.log_wage FROM education_levels e JOIN individuals i ON e.education_id = i.education WHERE e.education_id IN ( SELECT education_id FROM individuals WHERE ability IS NOT NULL AND log_wage IS NOT NULL GROUP BY education_id ORDER BY education_level ASC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(1) > 0 ) ORDER BY e.education_level, log_wage DESC LIMIT 6
sub-database-3.656: SELECT geographic_location, potential_experience, log_wage, SUM(log_wage) OVER(PARTITION BY geographic_location ORDER BY potential_experience) AS cumulative_log_wage, AVG(log_wage) OVER(PARTITION BY geographic_location) AS average_log_wage FROM individuals ORDER BY geographic_location, potential_experience;
sub-database-3.657: SELECT ic.cell_type_name, sm.analysis_date, SUM(sicc.proportion) AS cumulative_proportion FROM immune_cells ic JOIN sample_immune_cell_composition sicc ON ic.cell_type_id = sicc.cell_type_id JOIN samples s ON sicc.sample_id = s.sample_id JOIN statistical_measures sm ON s.sample_id = sm.sample_id WHERE ic.cell_type_name = 'specific immune cell type' GROUP BY ic.cell_type_name, sm.analysis_date ORDER BY sm.analysis_date;
